_note: Boons. `tags` = families (see `families`): collecting distinct boons of a family unlocks its 2/4/6 bonuses. `stack`: true = can be taken again with no limit, each copy adds its stats again. effect keys: flag (read by CombatSim), stats (numbers summed per stack), skill_bonus. desc may hold {tokens} filled with live numbers by DSRunState.boon_desc(). Total percent damage reduction is capped at 90%.

vampiric_edge.name: Vampiric Edge
vampiric_edge.desc: Heal for 6% of all damage you deal.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.desc: Every kill heals 8% of your max HP ({kill_heal} HP).

hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.desc: Critical hits make the target bleed for {bleed} damage a turn for 3 turns.

adrenaline.name: Adrenaline
adrenaline.desc: Below 50% HP, heal for an extra 10% of the damage you deal.

troll_blood.name: Troll Blood
troll_blood.desc: Regenerate 1% of your max HP every turn ({regen} HP).

second_life.name: Second Life
second_life.desc: Once per run, a killing blow leaves you at half HP ({half} HP) instead. Each stack is one more.

static_charge.name: Static Charge
static_charge.desc: Your hits have a 15% chance to zap a nearby enemy for {zap} lightning damage.

keen_eye.name: Keen Eye
keen_eye.desc: +8% chance for any hit to crit (crits deal +75%).

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.desc: Each melee turn has a 20% chance to strike one extra time.

overkill.name: Overkill
overkill.desc: When you kill, 50% of the leftover damage hits another nearby enemy.

whetstone.name: Whetstone
whetstone.desc: +2 damage on every hit you land.

frostbite.name: Frostbite
frostbite.desc: Your hits have an 8% chance to freeze the target for a turn.

cold_snap.name: Cold Snap
cold_snap.desc: +25% damage to frozen, stunned or slowed enemies.

hoarfrost.name: Hoarfrost
hoarfrost.desc: Enemies that hit you in melee have a 10% chance to freeze for a turn.

glacial_edge.name: Glacial Edge
glacial_edge.desc: Your hits have a 12% chance to slow the target for 3 turns.

rot_touch.name: Rot Touch
rot_touch.desc: Your hits have a 15% chance to poison the target: {poison} damage a turn for 3 turns.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.desc: Each poison tick has a 15% chance to spread to another enemy near you, and poisoned enemies spread it to their neighbours when they die.

volatile.name: Volatile
volatile.desc: Slain enemies explode, dealing 20% of their max HP to enemies next to you (about {boom} against foes like these).

iron_skin.name: Iron Skin
iron_skin.desc: Take 2 less damage from every hit.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.desc: After you take damage, gain a shield that absorbs {bulwark} damage for 2 turns.

spiked_hide.name: Spiked Hide
spiked_hide.desc: Enemies that hit you in melee take {thorns} damage back.

last_bastion.name: Last Bastion
last_bastion.desc: Below 40% HP, take 25% less damage. (Total damage reduction caps at 90%.)

back_to_the_wall.name: Back to the Wall
back_to_the_wall.desc: While 2 or more enemies are on you, take 15% less damage. (Total damage reduction caps at 90%.)

counterstrike.name: Counterstrike
counterstrike.desc: After you parry, dodge or block, 30% chance to strike back at once.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.desc: Once per fight, a killing blow leaves you at 1 HP instead. Each stack is one more per fight.

retaliation.name: Retaliation
retaliation.desc: After you take damage, your next hit deals +25% damage.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.desc: Each kill gives +8% damage for 5 turns. Kills stack it and refresh the timer.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.desc: The first time you drop below 30% HP in a fight, heal 15% of your max HP. Each stack is one more heal.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.desc: Hits on enemies below 20% HP have a 10% chance to kill them outright (not bosses).

first_blood.name: First Blood
first_blood.desc: Your first hit in each fight deals +100% damage.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.desc: Killing a frozen, stunned or slowed enemy deals 30% of its max HP to enemies next to you.

rime_armor.name: Rime Armor
rime_armor.desc: While an enemy next to you is frozen, stunned or slowed, take 15% less damage. (Total damage reduction caps at 90%.)

toxic_blood.name: Toxic Blood
toxic_blood.desc: Enemies that hit you in melee have a 20% chance to be poisoned.

concussive_bash.name: Concussive Bash
concussive_bash.desc: Bash also slows the target for 2 rounds.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.desc: Each parry adds +5% damage to your next swing, stacking to 5.

forked_bolt.name: Forked Bolt
forked_bolt.desc: Chain lightning jumps one extra time.

war_mender.name: War Mender
war_mender.desc: Warcry also heals 15% of your max HP.

bone_breaker.name: Bone Breaker
bone_breaker.desc: Kick has a 25% chance to stun for a round.

evasive_counter.name: Evasive Counter
evasive_counter.desc: After you dodge or sidestep, your next swing deals +50% damage.

crushing_fist.name: Crushing Fist
crushing_fist.desc: Magic fist deals +50% damage to enemies above half HP.

soul_siphon.name: Soul Siphon
soul_siphon.desc: Each kill restores 10% of your mana.

whirling_blades.name: Whirling Blades
whirling_blades.desc: Whirlwind always strikes each enemy at least twice.

cobra_strike.name: Cobra Strike
cobra_strike.desc: In cobra dance, every parry triggers a counter-swing.

bleeding_cross.name: Bleeding Cross
bleeding_cross.desc: Cross slash leaves the target bleeding for 3 rounds.

storm_caller.name: Storm Caller
storm_caller.desc: Storm of blades no longer needs the storm dance.

blood.name: Blood
blood.desc: Life leech, healing on kills, bleeding.

4.text: +15% chance to zap a nearby enemy on hit.
+25% damage to frozen, stunned or slowed enemies.

6.text: Poisoned enemies deal 25% less damage to you.

6.text: Reflect 20% of the damage you take back at the attacker.

fury.name: Fury
fury.desc: Damage that builds as the fight goes on.

4.text: After you take damage, your next hit deals +50%.
